wins.text: Worldwide sales of $22.4B increased 6.6% operationally; Innovative Medicine hit first-ever $14.5B quarter with 10 assets delivering double-digit growth
DARZALEX grew 21.3% to ~$2.9B, driven by 4.6-point share gains across all lines and 9.4-point share gains in frontline; 4 additional positive Phase III studies delivered in the quarter
CARVYKTI sales of $186M grew 59.9% on capacity expansion and strong demand; FDA approval received for earlier lines of therapy with positive overall survival data from CARTITUDE-4
SPRAVATO grew 60.8% driven by increased physician and patient confidence; Electrophysiology delivered 13.4% growth with Abiomed up 15.4% including DanGer Shock landmark survivability data
Free cash flow year-to-date of ~$7.5B vs. $5.5B in prior year period; adjusted operational EPS guidance raised by $0.05 per share before acquisition dilution, implying 8.2% YoY EPS growth at midpoint

risks.text: STELARA biosimilar entry in Europe anticipated late July 2024 and in the U.S. in 2025, expected to materially pressure Innovative Medicine H2 sales growth; REMICADE and SIMPONI European distribution rights returned in Q4 with limited Q3 sales expected

MedTech growth fell below expectations; full-year 2024 MedTech growth now guided closer to 6% vs. prior expectation of upper end of 5%-7% range, driven by China weakness and vision distributor destocking
Shockwave, Proteologix and NM26 acquisitions create $0.68/share EPS dilution in 2024; adjusted pretax operating margin now expected to decline 120 bps vs. prior +50 bps improvement guidance

Effective tax rate increased to 17.5%-18.5% for full year vs. 14.7% in Q2 2023, driven by OECD Pillar Two and nondeductible NM26 acquisition; unfavorable international audit settlements also impacted Q2
China VBP pricing pressure and anticorruption campaign headwinds impacting MedTech procedural volumes and HCP engagement across surgery, spine, sports and vision segments

guidance_items.detail: Full-year operational sales guidance raised by $500M to reflect Shockwave; now expects 6.1%-6.6% operational growth with midpoint of $89.4B; reported sales midpoint $88.2B (5% growth) after ~$1.2B FX headwind
Adjusted operational EPS raised $0.05 on underlying performance to $10.00-$10.10/share, but includes $0.68/share dilution from recent acquisitions; implies 8.2% YoY growth at midpoint
2024 adjusted pretax operating margin now expected to decline 120 bps due to acquisition dilution, reversing prior +50 bps improvement guidance
Net interest income guided to $300M-$400M, lower than prior guidance due to acquisition financing costs; effective tax rate now 17.5%-18.5% vs. prior lower expectation
MedTech full-year growth now expected closer to 6%, down from prior expectation of upper end of 5%-7% range; Innovative Medicine H2 growth expected lower than H1 due to STELARA biosimilar entry

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Competitive impact of rival PFA (pulse field ablation) system on Biosense Webster EP catheter business in the U.S. ahead of VARIPULSE approval
Payer efforts to extract greater rebates in 2025 to offset Part D redesign losses, beyond what J&J disclosed
IRA negotiated pricing outcomes for STELARA and XARELTO and DARZALEX FASPRO treatment as a separate product
